notes: Cash-basis school district; all funds (including School Nutrition and Activities) are presented as governmental funds, so business_type is null and no business-type lines. Governmental amounts are the Total Governmental Funds column (p3-5). Statement of Activities and Net Position on p1-2 is government-wide. 'Local sources' (7,569,558) split with split_from: General Fund lines from the p6 budget schedule (property, carline, motor vehicle taxes, tuition, interest, licenses, contributions, fines, private grants, miscellaneous; 6,880,929) plus the other funds' local sources by fund (Bond 633,909, Special Building 3,084, School Nutrition 6,529 from p3; Depreciation 32 p9; Employee Benefit computed 45,075, 1 below its p10 schedule because of report rounding). 'County sources' 70,845 split into 2110 county fines 70,495 (fines and forfeitures) and 2210 ESU 350 (p6). 'Other nonrevenue receipts' 1,556,236 split into General Fund 1,269,831 and Activities Fund 286,405 using the fund columns on p3; 'Student' support services 1,053,491 split into General Fund 712,874 and Activities Fund 340,617; 'Other disbursements' 168,602 split into General Fund column 47,054 and Special Building 121,548 (p4). Transfers in/out 452,687 each from p4. Detail: General Fund schedule (p6-8) is function-level only (not itemized by object); Depreciation Fund schedule (p9) has only 32 receipts and no disbursements, Employee Benefit (p10) local sources and other expenses, School Nutrition (p11), Special Building (p12), Bond (p13), Activities (p14) all recorded. General Fund column on p3 also includes Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (receipts 12,262,294 + 32 + 45,076 = 12,307,402). Beginning fund balance 2,377,925; roll-forward uses lines as printed and is off by 1 due to rounding in the report (see report_discrepancies). Governmental beginning/ending cash = fund balances (cash basis). Balance sheet from p2 (government-wide cash-basis net position; no liabilities). Read pages 1-14 of 14.
